title: anagallis alternifolia var. genuina
intro: Anagallis alternifolia var. genuina, commonly known as Pimpernel, is a perennial plant species in the Anagallis genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pimpernel include wound healing, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. Bioactive constituents of Pimpernel include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
